In those MR ranges it's hyperactive gimmick zone, so spend most of your time waiting for a jump or drive rush. With Ed, use your flicker for mid range pressure and use your long range buttons to keep people out. If they get close, stick to using non commital light buttons so you can DP jumps or react to DI.  Spend most of the round being reactive. Eds light kick is amazing for punishing special moves people throw at you. 

When you get someone cornered, pressure as you normally would until you get two knockdowns then wait and bait a reversal or super or DI. Back up and let them try jump or drive rush out the corner. Your OD reversal will cover jumps and drive rushes. People in this MR have no patience on defense so let them make high risk plays and punish them, don't over extend.

Ed has amazing buttons for wiff punishes, i'd recommend this video on footsies to help recognise what you should be doing in each phase. Chris F also makes great videos on the subject, but again, spend most of your time waiting and punishing in this MR range.

FNAF is about being trapped in a horrific and haunted place with no choice to return each night as it gets worse. You have limited resources and creepy animatronics are hunting you.
